name: Nearbase
line: Managed PostgreSQL with monthly compute and provisioned storage pricing.

free.text: No public free plan; sponsorship unclear; unpaid instances can be deleted

cells.metered: $14/mo estimate; 20 GB minimum storage in Singapore

sql.math: The total of $6 for compute plus (20 GB ÷ 10 × $3.60) is rounded up to $14. Tax is not included, and whether the workload fits is not proven.
The monthly base stays $14 with no queries. The full cost, with protection, needs off-site backup pricing.

files.math: Nearbase does not provide file storage.

jobs.math: Nearbase does not include a job runner or queue
